caption: The drawing depicts a piece of cloth, likely linen, with red embroidery in a symmetrical arrangement. The cloth is off-white or light beige in color, and it has fringed edges on the top and bottom. The embroidery is done in a single shade of red and features various geometric and floral motifs. At the top section, there are three tree-like designs spaced evenly. The central section includes a horizontal row of small plant and flower motifs above a zigzag border. Below the border, there are two birds facing each other with a larger central floral or tree motif between them, flanked by two more stylized plant motifs. The central area also contains the embroidered year "1849." The bottom section of the cloth displays three prominent vertical floral motifs, with the largest in the center and two similar but smaller designs on either side. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the red embroidery standing out against the lighter background.
title: Pa. German Linen Towel
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
